description: Abort ONE specific queued or running interaction by action_uid, preserving the rest of your queue. Prerequisite: you have a live avatar and the action_uid refers to an entry currently visible in perception.avatar.action_queue[].uid. Effect: emits VMNetInteractionCancelCmd scoped to that single uid; the engine cancels the targeted interaction at the next safe animation break (your Sim may finish a sub-animation before coming to rest) while leaving every other queued action untouched. The server re-verifies the uid against your queue; a stale uid is a no-op. Cost: whatever progress the cancelled interaction had made is lost (e.g. half-finished Sleep does not credit full Energy gain); other Sims observing you see that one action_queue entry disappear within one perception tick. This is the precision primitive — for the broad sweep 'cancel everything I'm doing' use the movement-family 'cancel' op (which fires one cancel-interaction per visible queue entry, matching stock UIInteractionQueue behaviour). Requiring action_uid here is a deliberate design fence: using this op forces the agent to cite which specific interaction it is aborting, which shows up in the audit log.

args.name: action_uid
args.description: ushort UID of a specific queued/running interaction, sourced from perception.avatar.action_queue[].uid. Zero is rejected — use the movement-family 'cancel' op (action_uid omitted) for the broad sweep.
